rationale: D4_stale_reference_data is supported: the shared condition-name registry omits the NPR category present in the supplied clause and includes an empty literal interpreted by the measured compiler as SPACE. Revised original executions confirm NPR rejection and blank acceptance. Inclusion is limited to finite category membership; document qualifications, full KYC compliance and successful remediation are not established.
scope_judgment: OVDLIST.cpy line 5 contains the complete accepted-category list and is a sufficient allowed locus for the stated membership change. OVDCHK1 consumes that condition-name directly. Only this supplied consumer is supported; broader copybook fan-out is unproven.
intended_fixture_judgment: The NPR acceptance and space-filled rejection fixtures initialize the actual three-character field, perform the screening paragraph and observe its decision. They cover the missing category and erroneous blank boundary. Both fail on the measured unchanged original, as expected for demonstrated drift. Issuer, signature and name/address requirements are absent from the model, so category acceptance cannot establish document validity.
regression_fixture_judgment: The fixtures cover all five unchanged named categories with ACCEPT expectations and one unknown code with REJECT. Revised original executions pass these six observations. Blank rejection is correctly treated as intended changed behavior rather than baseline preservation. Coverage establishes these finite outcomes only, without universal preservation over all other codes or end-to-end input behavior.
capability_judgment: The qualified GnuCOBOL 3.2 WSL evidence supplies actual original compilation and all eight fixture executions, including both intended failures. The historical Windows receipt and authoring statement about unexecuted new fixtures must remain separate from the later measured WSL observations. Capability receipts with case_checks_executed=false alone are not execution passes. No patched result, Windows portability proof or complete semantic equivalence is established; the disclosed static limitations remain applicable.
duplicate_source_judgment: Retaining the original frozen-manifest group and position is a defensible provenance justification for retaining a dependent case. The disclosed source_bundle_group must remain attached, case counts must be distinguished from distinct-bundle counts, and uncertainty must account for bundle dependence. Separate AI contexts do not make model errors independent. Other paired cases were not available for direct comparison in this packet.
unresolved_issues: Document qualifications and full KYC compliance remain outside the modeled scope.
Additional copybook consumers and universal behavior preservation are unproven.
